reviews.title: A TUF high quality PSU🛡️⚙️💪
reviews.comment: Since installing the ASUS TUF Gaming 1000W PSU, I can confidently say it delivers on quality and performance. This unit is currently powering my Ryzen 7 9800X3D, RTX 5070 Ti, 64GB of DDR5 RAM, three NVMe SSDs, and an AIO liquid cooler, and it has been absolutely flawless. Right out of the box, everything feels premium. The packaging is excellent, it includes TUF branded Velcro cable management straps, and even a certificate of testing, which is a really nice touch and inspires confidence. The PSU itself feels very solid and well built. The sleeved cables are fantastic. They look great, are very flexible, and are extremely easy to work with. Cable management was smooth, and the GPU power cable bends cleanly without feeling stiff or putting stress on the connector, which made installation much easier. In terms of performance, the system runs quiet and stable, with no electrical noise or issues, even under load. Having the extra wattage provides plenty of headroom and peace of mind for light CPU tuning and future upgrades. Overall, this feels like a high quality, long term investment. If you are looking for a reliable and well built PSU that can comfortably handle a high end system, I highly recommend this one.
reviews.author: Mr. Next Level

reviews.title: Really good :)
reviews.comment: The size of the power supply is pretty good not really much to say on that, The colors of the cables obviously are going to be blocked out so they could be pretty good if you want to make a all black PC and the quality of the cables are pretty good too feeling pretty reliable and durable and the installation is pretty easy and understandable to do and of course due to it being a modular power supply you don't need to have every single cable plugged in. So I would say this is a pretty good power supply especially a 1000 w unit even if my PC does not consume anywhere near 500w but it's still good to have a lot of headroom for future upgrading.

reviews.title: Great PSU for a GEFORCE4090
reviews.comment: I bought this PSU to connect it to a GEFORCE RTX4090 card. Both PSU and card are connected to a DEG1 eGPU dock (Minisforum). Connecting the unit took around 10 min total. I did run a number of tests with the setup, and the system worked well even under demanding conditions. Noise level is really low. Overall, a very good buy for me.

reviews.title: Tuff Military Grade PSU
reviews.comment: Just to be safe, I upgraded from an 850W PSU when switching to the AM5-DDR5 socket level. Believe it or not I had unexplained crashes with the 850W with mild over/under clocking. Which made no sense, until I saw how unlocked CPU’s actually are & some GPU’s. If you ever had a crash when starting up a game or application, 90% of the time the total wattage went over your PSU’s head. Which shouldn’t matter right.. but some just shut right down kernel critical. With this PSU iv had no unexplained crashes, cable management is decent. The value is the quality, I know this thing can handle more than 1K for a little while. Idk for sure but gots a feeling, seen some reviews, seen some vids. Seen some tests, don’t cheap out on the PSU. Cheap out on the Ram, if ya have too instead. I don’t even have crazy specs, $200 cpu & 400 GPU, both known for not blowing a hole in your wall. But the cpu can draw up to 400 watts when it’s overclocked, even under at a stock 1.3voltage. Incredible. I toned it down a bit but just because your voltages are low doesn’t mean your power consumption is. End
